0x124.name: WHEA_UNCORRECTABLE_ERROR
0x124.description: A fatal hardware error has occurred. Usually CPU, memory, or PCIe related.
common_causes: CPU voltage instability (Vmin Shift on Intel 13th/14th gen)
Memory timing too aggressive (XMP profile issues)
remediation: Check CPU microcode version — apply latest Intel update
Disable XMP and test with JEDEC memory speeds
Run Prime95 Small FFTs for 30 minutes to stress-test CPU
Check Event Viewer for WHEA-Logger events with error source details

0x9C.name: MACHINE_CHECK_EXCEPTION
0x9C.description: CPU detected an unrecoverable hardware error during execution.
common_causes: Insufficient CPU core voltage under load
remediation: Contact manufacturer for RMA if persistent

0xD1.name: DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL
0xD1.description: A kernel-mode driver attempted to access pageable memory at too high an IRQL.
common_causes: Anti-cheat kernel driver conflict (Vanguard, EAC, BattlEye)
VPN or firewall filter driver issue
remediation: Identify the faulting driver from the dump file
Update or roll back the identified driver
Disable conflicting filter drivers and test

41.description: Unexpected shutdown/reboot — no clean shutdown was initiated
41.analysis_notes: Check BugcheckCode parameter: 0=power loss, non-zero=BSOD crash code

source: Microsoft WHEA Documentation + Community Knowledge Base
